name: The leaving letter
description: A send-off from a whole team: a gallery, a timeline of the years, and room for everyone to say the thing they never said.
tagline: For someone the office will miss

defaults.title: Before you go
defaults.openingMessage: We couldn't fit this on a card, so we didn't try.
defaults.closingMessage: Go and be brilliant somewhere else. Reluctantly, we approve.

copy.envelope.title: Before you go.
copy.envelope.subtitle: From all of us.
copy.welcome.subtitle: We had things to say. Here they are.
copy.gallery.title: The evidence
copy.timeline.title: The years, briefly
copy.closing.title: Go and be brilliant somewhere else.
copy.surprise.intro: One last thing from the team.

content.text: Write the group's version here — why the place will be different without them. Keep it warm and keep it short; the individual notes below do the heavy lifting.
Paste each person's note here, with their name underneath. One paragraph each is plenty — ask for a specific memory rather than a compliment.
Replace this with the line they were famous for saying in stand-up.

content.caption: Away days, launches, and at least one bad hat.

content.text: For when you need one of these
A couple of sealed notes — a reference they can point to, a reminder for the new job's harder days.
Keep in touch properly, not in the way people say they will.
